# Southeastern District Office - Fall River

## Contact Information

218 South Main St., Suite 206 Fall River, MA 02721

## The following services are provided at the Fall River office.

### Corporations

Southeastern Office can provide you with limited information over the phone about the approximately 400,000 profit and non-profit corporations doing business in Massachusetts. This data includes the date of incorporation, location, and the names of the officers. This office also provides Good Standings, Legal Existence, and Certified Copies as well as Name Reservations for Corporate Entities.

### Public Records and Commissions

The Southeastern Office can administer the oath of office to public officials, notaries public and justices of the peace. An oath of office requires an appointment in advance. This office also certifies the signatures of public officials and affixes Apostilles to documents going out of the country.

### Elections

The Southeastern office offers state election candidate information, distribution and acceptance of nomination papers for those seeking office, election laws and statistics, and “how to” pamphlets on election procedures. Voter registration forms are also available.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
